name: Security article quoting an attack phrase, with an unrelated tag run
notes: The false positive the #34 fix must not reopen. The quoted phrase is not anchored, so the plain pass correctly ignores it; an unrelated subdivision flag in the same leaf flips the segment to 'concealed', and a relaxed rescan of the whole segment would block an article a reviewer can read in full. Counting occurrences cancels it against its own copy in the masked view.

content.text: An article about prompt injection quotes 'ignore all previous instructions' as an example. See the 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 regional guidance.
